grammar.text: Audit records and action states support traceability and replay prevention.
The implemented system follows a client–server architecture with a React and TypeScript frontend and a Spring Boot backend exposing REST APIs.
Let tf(t,d) denote the frequency of term t in document d, let N be the number of documents in the reference corpus, and let df(t) be the number of documents containing t.
The exact formulation changes numeric scores, so a thesis must document the implemented formula rather than referring to TF-IDF as if it were a single universal function.

A controlled or static reference corpus can improve score stability because the IDF of a term does not change whenever a user adds one document; however, it may become less representative as technologies and hiring terminology evolve.
Given a query representation q and a candidate set D, the system computes a relevance score s(q,d) for each d ∈ D and orders the results by decreasing score.
qₘ = αq₀ + (β / |Dᵣ|) Σ(d ∈ Dᵣ) d − (γ / |Dₙᵣ|) Σ(d ∈ Dₙᵣ) d.
The parameters α, β, and γ control retention of the original representation, attraction toward relevant examples, and movement away from non-relevant examples.
DCG@K = Σ(i=1..K) (2^relᵢ − 1) / log₂(i + 1),     nDCG@K = DCG@K / IDCG@K.
Human involvement can occur during data validation, model configuration, review of recommendations, approval of actions, exception handling, and post-action feedback.

REST is an architectural style characterized by constraints including client–server separation, stateless interaction, cacheability where appropriate, a uniform interface, layered components, and optional code-on-demand [11].
These concepts must remain separate: a high similarity score must not silently become an application, and an application status must not be interpreted as a relevance label.
The backend normalizes and vectorizes the job, persists ownership through recruiter_id, and makes eligible jobs available for matching.
run-now provides a controlled testing path without changing the policy semantics.
This is not a microservice architecture: modules share one process, one primary PostgreSQL database, common security and exception handling, and direct in-process service calls.
user_account stores identity, role, activation, verification, language, and password hash.
A Candidate account owns one candidate profile and multiple cv, portfolio link, and portfolio project records.
job stores the original JD, structured recruitment attributes, salary mode, language, status, source provenance, and vector data.
matching is the unique association between one CV and one job.
application links Candidate and Job and may reference the CV and Matching used at application time.
feedback links a Matching with its actor and source channel.
recommendation_interaction records behavioral events such as viewed, skipped, applied, saved, not interested, or show similar.
automation_policy stores one policy per user.
email_action and email_token currently represent two distinct tokenized workflows.
audit_log stores actor, action, target, result, source channel, request metadata, and structured metadata.
A backend process running directly on the host connects to localhost:5433; the backend container connects through the Compose network to postgres:5432.
Environment variables override database credentials, JWT secret, application base URL, CORS origins, mail settings, OCR executable and languages, and storage path.
Domain packages include auth, candidate, cv, job, employer, matching, recommendation, application, feedback, automation, notification, analytics, admin, audit, and settings.
Each authenticated request passes through JwtAuthenticationFilter, a OncePerRequestFilter.
The default OCR language set is vie+eng, the default maximum is eight pages, and each OCR process has a timeout.
An unknown term receives log(1 + N), which treats it as rare and informative.
saveAndFlush exposes uniqueness conflicts within the service transaction, which are converted into an HTTP conflict response.
AfterCommitExecutor registers CV and Job matching work with Spring transaction synchronization and submits it only after commit.
This distinction must remain explicit: notification gating and application authorization are related but not identical mechanisms.
protectedRoute checks the loaded account role, while reload restoration calls /api/auth/me and clears an invalid session.

It reads VITE_API_BASE_URL with /api as the default, attaches the bearer token from sessionStorage, selects JSON headers except for multipart FormData, unwraps the shared response envelope, and throws a normalized error for unsuccessful responses.
Host execution connects to localhost:5433; container execution connects to postgres:5432.
The frontend development server runs on 127.0.0.1:5173 and uses /api or a configured API base URL.

It covered security, post-commit CV and Job processing, TF-IDF scoring, Candidate feedback with Rocchio, privacy-gated portfolios, application workflows, AutoFit notifications, hardened email actions, frontend integration, and runtime monitoring.
Feedback learning is registered after transaction commit, and benchmark setup removes prior Matchings in bulk and clears the persistence context before recomputation.
npm run build performs TypeScript checking with no output emission and then builds the production assets with Vite 6.4.3.
Scripted E2E success measures workflow execution, not usability or user trust.
The benchmark runs inside a Spring context, so asynchronous work and persisted Matching records can affect repeatability if they are not controlled.
CV–JD matching and profile-oriented recommendation remain separate workflows, and Matching state remains separate from Application state.
AutoFit policies store thresholds, enablement, notification preferences, cooldown, quota, quiet-hour, timezone, digest, and pause settings.
Auto-apply validates the default CV, Job status, threshold, and duplicate state and limits creation to three applications per run.

Human-in-the-Loop in CareerFit is expressed through multiple control points: users supply and validate data, inspect reasons, configure policy, apply or invite, provide feedback, pause automation, and review audit history.

Audit records are still written directly by multiple services, and the evaluated worktree is not an immutable release commit; those limitations weaken production operations and exact source-to-evidence reproducibility.
A controlled user study should measure task completion, time, comprehension of explanations, trust calibration, and ability to override automation.
